name: attach
wording: the operator joining the running session of whichever agent holds a gate, a delegate's included, to give its sign-off there and work with that agent directly, by the harness's own way of joining a session; each harness's way is projected for it, omp's natively, and a harness with none has no gate held by a delegate.
reason: A gate is held in the session of the party whose handover it is, so the operator must be able to join a delegate's session; how a harness lets it do so is delivery's to project, harness by harness, and attach is the established name for joining a running session.
